why: KARAR A29 (defter O90): attached-message bubbles rendered empty on desktop - no thumbnail, no dragged filename, only the timestamp. Root cause: `attachments` is out of sync scope (protocol §1.3), `messages` mirrored only `attachment_id`, and `mapMessage` hard-coded `attachment: null`. The fix flattens the attachment's metadata onto the `messages` pull row as four fields (`SyncPullService::attachMessageAttachments()`), sourced from the same shape `ChatAttachmentResource::payload()` builds for the web client. This fixture is generated from the REAL wire response of `POST /api/sync/pull` (see server.scenario), not hand-typed - including the space-separated `created_at`/`updated_at` format `DB::table()` really produces (defter O81/O83), which differs from the ISO-8601 shape Eloquent casts would produce.
completeness_note: The `row` below is a SUBSET of the real pull row, not the whole of it. Consumers therefore assert containment, never equality: the backend proves every key here appears in what SyncPullService produced, and the crate proves every non-envelope key here has a mirror column.
envelope_note: `upsert_row` handles these three itself - `id` becomes `server_id`, `client_id` is the primary key, `sync_version` becomes `server_sync_version` - so they are the three keys that must NOT be looked for as columns of the same name.

mapped.note: What `mappers.ts::mapMessage` must read off the row above. The four `attachment_*` fields are the ONLY source for the mirror's attachment columns - `is_image` is never re-derived client-side from `attachment_mime` (K7: one definition, ChatAttachmentResource::payload()).
